name: Evidence-First Review
summary: Author, reviewer and merger are different identities. Verdicts are reproducible findings on the exact head, every tested claim carries an evidence table, and a hook stops the author from merging or force-pushing.

agentProfiles.tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Edit, Write, Bash
Read, git diff, git show, gh pr view
agentProfiles.limits: Cannot edit or merge; never reviews its own session

changelog.note: Merge guard reads each command the way the shell splits it: quotes, backslashes, comments and here-documents. It now also blocks git push \-f, "git" push -f and git -C "my dir" push -f, force pushes and merges inside bash -c, sh -c, eval and command substitutions or in a here-document or pipe that a shell reads, and anything nested more than three levels deep. Text that only mentions a force push, such as a quoted commit message or a here-document body, no longer blocks. The plugin manifest now links the public Build repository.

Merge guard also blocks git push -f as the first argument, flag clusters such as -fu, --mirror, git -C <dir> push, git called by its path, and pushes or merges inside ( ) or { }. Only git's subcommand counts and each command is checked on its own, so a commit message that mentions git push --force, or a force flag on a later command (git push; rm -f x), no longer blocks.
Season 0 release: review contract, evidence table, independent reviewer, merge guard.
